tasks.gr11-physics-consolidation-t4: Topic: Physics Consolidation — Grade 11. Integrate mechanics (vectors, Newton's laws, work/energy/power, momentum, impulse, vertical projectile motion) and electricity (electrostatics, Coulomb's law, electric fields, circuits, emf). Emphasise correct formula selection, multi-step calculation procedures, units and significant figures, graph interpretation (v-t graphs for projectiles, force-time graphs for impulse, I-V graphs for Ohm's law), and free-body diagram construction. Ask Grade 11 learners to solve integrated mechanics and electricity problems, interpret data from tables and graphs, identify errors in reasoning, and demonstrate systematic calculation technique.
tasks.gr11-chemistry-consolidation-t4: Topic: Chemistry Consolidation — Grade 11. Integrate organic chemistry (IUPAC naming, functional groups, homologous series trends), intermolecular forces (types, polarity, physical properties), redox reactions (oxidation numbers, half-reactions, oxidising and reducing agents), and electrochemical cells (galvanic vs electrolytic, EMF calculation, cell notation). Emphasise precise scientific terminology, explaining property trends using particle-level reasoning, and constructing balanced equations. Ask Grade 11 learners to name organic compounds, identify functional groups, explain property differences using IMFs, assign oxidation numbers, balance redox equations, and label electrochemical cell diagrams.
tasks.gr11-final-exam-prep-t4: Topic: Final Examination Preparation — Grade 11 Physical Sciences. Cover Paper 1 structure (physics: approximately 150 marks; Section A — multiple choice and short questions; Section B — longer calculations on mechanics and electricity) and Paper 2 structure (chemistry: approximately 150 marks; organic chemistry, IMFs, redox, electrochemistry). Address exam strategies: identifying key words in questions, showing full working for method marks, checking units and significant figures, allocating time per mark, and avoiding common errors. Ask Grade 11 learners to apply integrated knowledge across all Grade 11 topics, practise answering multi-mark structured questions, and demonstrate clear scientific reasoning in both papers.
tasks.gr11-mining-minerals-t4: Topic: Mining and mineral processing (the lithosphere). Cover the lithosphere (crust and upper mantle), non-renewable fossil fuels and minerals and renewable soil nutrients, ore, resource and reserve, the uneven distribution of elements and the most abundant elements in the crust (oxygen 46%, silicon 28%, aluminium 8%, iron 5%, rounded), the methods of recovering a metal (physical, heating alone, heating with carbon), the recovery of gold (deep-level mining, crushing, dissolving in sodium cyanide and oxygen as an oxidation, precipitation with zinc as a reduction, smelting; the Witwatersrand and the Free State), and the effects of old and modern mining on the environment. Ask Grade 11 learners to define terms, sequence the steps and use balanced equations. Do not ask about production figures or prices.
